docs: 策略金库的 Anchor 指令入口。
Anchor instruction entry points for the GGBOY strategy vault.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: 将投资者的结算资产转入金库，按存入前的净值铸造份额。
Transfer the investor's settlement asset into custody and mint shares at the pre-deposit NAV.
`context` 包含签名的投资者、已配置的金库账户和投资者的代币账户。
`context` contains the signing investor, configured vault accounts, and investor token accounts.
`assets_in` 是 mockUSDC 最小单位数，`min_shares_out` 是 GG-V 最小单位数，两者均须为正。
`assets_in` is in mockUSDC base units and `min_shares_out` is in GG-V base units. Both must be positive.
成功时转账、铸造并记录成交事件。任何校验或代币操作失败时，整笔存入回滚。
Success transfers funds, mints shares, and emits a receipt event. Failed checks or token operations revert the deposit.

accounts.name: investor
docs: 授权扣款且持有接收份额账户的投资者签名人。
Investor signer authorizing the debit and owning the share destination.

accounts.name: vault
docs: 已初始化的金库 PDA，绑定本笔交易可使用的资产、托管账户和份额 Mint。
Initialized vault PDA binding the asset, custody account, and share mint used in this deposit.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: 配置中的 mockUSDC Mint，为转账提供绑定地址及小数位数。
Configured mockUSDC mint supplying the bound address and decimals for the transfer.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 金库控制的结算资产账户，存入前余额用于报价，存入后接收资金。
Vault-controlled settlement account whose pre-deposit balance prices the new shares and receives the funds.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: 金库拥有铸造权的 GG-V Mint，读取操作前总供给并增加实际铸造量。
GG-V mint authorized by the vault, supplying the prior total supply and recording newly minted shares.

accounts.name: investor_asset
docs: 已存在并由投资者拥有的 mockUSDC 扣款账户。
Existing investor-owned mockUSDC source account.

accounts.name: investor_shares
docs: 已存在并由投资者拥有的 GG-V 到账账户。
Existing investor-owned GG-V destination account.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 执行实际转账与铸造的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program executing the transfer and mint.

instructions.name: initialize_vault
docs: 由程序升级权限持有者创建唯一金库，并把托管和份额铸造权授予金库 PDA。
Create the singleton vault as the program upgrade authority and assign custody and minting to its PDA.
`context` 包含管理员签名、六位小数的结算 Mint 和待创建的账户。
`context` contains the administrator signature, the six-decimal settlement mint, and the new accounts.
成功时三个账户同时建立。权限、资产或地址校验失败会回滚整个初始化。
All three accounts are created together. Permission, asset, or address validation failures revert initialization.

accounts.name: administrator
docs: 管理员签名并支付三个新账户的免租金余额，单位为 lamports。
Administrator signs and funds the rent-exempt balance of all three new accounts, in lamports.

accounts.name: vault_program
docs: 当前部署的金库程序，Anchor 校验其地址和可执行状态。
The deployed vault program, with its address and executable status checked by Anchor.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: 从当前程序的 ProgramData 读取升级权限，防止借用其他程序的权限。
Read upgrade authority from this program's ProgramData to bind initialization to this deployment.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: 管理员选定的经典 SPL 结算 Mint。Anchor 校验归属及初始化状态。
Classic SPL settlement mint selected by the administrator. Anchor checks its owner and initialized state.

accounts.name: vault
docs: 金库状态和代币操作的授权地址。单次创建防止覆盖已有配置。
Vault state and token authority. One-time creation protects the existing configuration.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 新建的空现金账户，绑定结算 Mint 并由金库 PDA 授权。
New empty cash account bound to the settlement mint and controlled by the vault PDA.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: 新建的六位小数份额 Mint。初始供给为零，无冻结权限。
New six-decimal share mint with zero initial supply and no freeze authority.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 执行托管账户及份额 Mint 初始化的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program that initializes the custody account and share mint.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 为三个新账户分配链上空间及免租金余额的系统程序。
System program that allocates space and rent-exempt balances for the new accounts.

instructions.name: ping
docs: 验证脚手架指令可以调用，返回成功且不读写链上账户。
Confirm the scaffold instruction is callable and return success without accessing on-chain accounts.
`_context` 是 Anchor 传入的指令上下文，本指令无需读取其中的数据。
`_context` is the Anchor instruction context. This instruction does not read it.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: 按赎回前的净值销毁投资者份额，并从纯现金金库支付结算资产。
Burn investor shares at the pre-redemption NAV and pay the settlement asset from cash custody.
`context` 包含投资者签名、已配置的金库账户和投资者的代币账户。
`context` contains the investor signer, configured vault accounts, and investor token accounts.
`shares_in` 是 GG-V 最小单位数，`min_assets_out` 是 mockUSDC 最小单位数，两者均须为正。
`shares_in` is in GG-V base units and `min_assets_out` is in mockUSDC base units. Both must be positive.
销毁、支付及成交记录在同一笔交易执行。任一代币操作失败时回滚赎回。
The burn, payment, and receipt occur in one transaction. Either token operation failing reverts the redemption.

accounts.name: investor
docs: 授权销毁自己的份额并拥有结算资产收款账户的投资者签名人。
Investor signer authorizing the burn and owning the settlement destination.

accounts.name: vault
docs: 已初始化的金库 PDA，限制两种 Mint 和托管账户为初始化时绑定的地址。
Initialized vault PDA restricting both mints and custody to the bound addresses.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: 金库配置的 mockUSDC Mint，支付时按其链上精度检查转账。
Configured mockUSDC mint whose on-chain decimals are checked during payment.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 金库 PDA 控制的现金账户，赎回前的余额是定价和支付上限的依据。
Vault-controlled cash account whose prior balance prices and caps the payout.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: 金库 PDA 具有铸造权限的 GG-V Mint，读取原总量并扣除被销毁的份额。
GG-V mint under vault mint authority, read before burning and debited by the burn.

accounts.name: investor_asset
docs: 已存在并由投资者拥有的 mockUSDC 收款账户。
Existing investor-owned mockUSDC payout account.

accounts.name: investor_shares
docs: 已存在并由投资者拥有的 GG-V 份额来源账户。
Existing investor-owned GG-V source account for the burn.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 执行份额销毁和结算资产转账的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program executing the share burn and settlement transfer.

errors.name: InvalidProgramData
errors.msg: ProgramData does not match the vault program

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdministrator
errors.msg: Only the vault program upgrade authority can initialize the vault

errors.name: InvalidAssetDecimals
errors.msg: The settlement mint must have six decimals

errors.name: InvalidDepositAmount
errors.msg: Deposit amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidMinimumSharesOut
errors.msg: Minimum shares out must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidVaultPricingState
errors.msg: Vault cash and share supply are inconsistent for deposit pricing

errors.name: DepositSharesOverflow
errors.msg: Calculated share amount exceeds the token amount range

errors.name: ZeroSharesOut
errors.msg: Deposit rounds down to zero shares

errors.name: MinimumSharesOutNotMet
errors.msg: Calculated share output is below the minimum

errors.name: InsufficientDepositBalance
errors.msg: Insufficient settlement asset balance for the deposit

errors.name: InvalidRedeemAmount
errors.msg: Redemption shares must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidMinimumAssetsOut
errors.msg: Minimum assets out must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientRedeemShares
errors.msg: Insufficient shares in the redemption source account

errors.name: InvalidRedemptionPricingState
errors.msg: Share supply cannot support redemption pricing

errors.name: ZeroAssetsOut
errors.msg: Redemption rounds down to zero settlement assets

errors.name: InsufficientVaultCash
errors.msg: Vault cash is insufficient for redemption

errors.name: MinimumAssetsOutNotMet
errors.msg: Calculated redemption payout is below the minimum

types.name: Vault
docs: 记录单个金库的管理员、资产账户绑定和授权 PDA 参数。
Stores the singleton vault administrator, asset account bindings, and authority PDA parameter.

fields.name: administrator
docs: 初始化时签名的管理员钱包公钥。
Public key of the administrator who signed initialization.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: 初始化时绑定的六位小数结算资产 Mint 公钥。
Public key of the six-decimal settlement mint bound during initialization.

fields.name: cash_vault
docs: 金库 PDA 控制的现金托管账户公钥。
Public key of the cash custody account controlled by the vault PDA.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: 金库 PDA 独占铸造权的 GG-V 份额 Mint 公钥。
Public key of the GG-V mint whose mint authority is the vault PDA.

fields.name: bump
docs: Anchor 派生的规范 bump，后续用于授权金库 PDA 的代币操作。
Canonical bump derived by Anchor for future vault PDA token operations.

types.name: VaultDeposit
docs: 成功存入后供交易索引器读取的实际成交数据。
Executed deposit details for the transaction indexer.

fields.name: vault
docs: 处理存入的金库 PDA 公钥。
Public key of the vault PDA processing the deposit.

fields.name: investor
docs: 签名并收取份额的投资者公钥。
Public key of the investor who signed and received shares.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: 实际转入的结算资产 Mint 公钥。
Public key of the settlement mint transferred into the vault.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: 实际铸造的 GG-V 份额 Mint 公钥。
Public key of the GG-V share mint issued by the deposit.

fields.name: assets_in
docs: 实际转入金库的 mockUSDC 最小单位数。
Number of mockUSDC base units transferred into custody.

fields.name: shares_out
docs: 实际到账的 GG-V 最小单位数。
Number of GG-V base units minted to the investor.

types.name: VaultRedeem
docs: 成功赎回的实际销毁和到账数据，供交易索引器读取。
Executed burn and payout details for the transaction indexer.

fields.name: vault
docs: 处理赎回的金库 PDA 公钥。
Public key of the vault PDA processing the redemption.

fields.name: investor
docs: 签名、销毁份额并收款的投资者公钥。
Public key of the investor who signed, burned shares, and received payment.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: 实际付出的 mockUSDC Mint 公钥。
Public key of the mockUSDC mint paid out.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: 实际被销毁的 GG-V Mint 公钥。
Public key of the GG-V mint whose shares were burned.

fields.name: shares_in
docs: 已销毁的 GG-V 最小单位数。
Number of GG-V base units burned.

fields.name: assets_out
docs: 到账的 mockUSDC 最小单位数。
Number of mockUSDC base units paid out.
